author: buildat
name: brimstone_stunts
title: Brimstone Stunts
description: Brimstone's junkyard death race, the camera chasing the car: heavy old cars round a dirt track of hairpins, chicanes, mud and oil. A time trial against the clock, or a race from a grid: crates with guns, mines and a ram boost, wrecks that burn, places in finishing order.
